payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over grid (i,j) storing a map from constant path value to min ops; transitions keep constant if possible or reduce it, adding cost proportional to path length.
payload.rationale: The solution uses nested loops over rows and columns, maintaining per-cell dictionaries (dp[i][j]). This is classic 2D grid DP with an additional state dimension, fitting dp_2d_state.
